units.source_text: 我的院是为了生而企图焚毁金阁寺的，

en.t: My temple had plotted to burn down the Golden Pavilion in order to live,

units.source_text: 但我正在做的事却似做好的准备。

en.t: but what I was doing now seemed like preparations already made.

units.source_text: 如同决心自杀的贞操男子在自杀前去寻花问柳一样，

en.t: Just as a chaste man resolved to kill himself might visit the pleasure quarter before his death,
I too was going to the pleasure quarter.
There was no need to worry.

units.source_text: 这种男人的行为就像在公文格式上署个名，

en.t: The act of such a man is like signing his name on an official form,

units.source_text: 即使失去了贞操，他也绝不会变成"另一个人"的。

en.t: and even if he loses his chastity, he will never become "another person."
